parameters.name: CertificateId
parameters.description: The certificate ID. You must specify either CertificateId or OrderId. Both cannot be empty at the same time.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return in this request.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next query. If NextToken is empty, no more results are available.

parameters.name: OrderId
parameters.description: The order ID. You must specify either CertificateId or OrderId. Both cannot be empty at the same time.
